items.title: AWS refreshes ProcessUnity Global Risk Exchange assessment to enhance customer’s third-party due diligence
items.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is pleased to announce renewal of the AWS ProcessUnity Global Risk Exchange assessment. This validated assessment report helps customers perform effective cloud supplier due diligence on AWS and enhances their third-party risk management process. What is the AWS ProcessUnity Global Risk Exchange assessment Many customers use third-party cyber risk management (TPCRM) […]
